suite: SP-8C-7A / SP-8C-7B Negative Test & Boundary Execution Harness

results.name: Image Absence Fail-Closed
results.assertion: Verifier must exit 1 and record IMAGE_NOT_PRESENT when docker image inspect fails

results.name: Docker Operational Failure Handling
observed_markers: Docker operational failure / daemon error fail-closed
results.assertion: Verifier must fail closed with exit 1 if Docker daemon communication fails

results.name: Container Name Collision Rejection
results.assertion: Verifier must reject execution if inspection container name already exists

results.name: Inspection Container Cleanup Failure Containment
results.assertion: Verifier cleanup failure must force exit code 1 and prevent silent exit

results.name: Compose JSON AST Model Rejection
results.assertion: AST auditor must reject invalid service profiles, missing services, or rogue named backup volumes

results.name: Atomic Multi-Element PIPESTATUS Validation
results.assertion: Wrapper must atomically detect and trap non-zero payload status from pipeline

results.name: Canonical Log Collision & Symlink Trap
results.assertion: Wrapper must reject pre-existing log files or symlinks without mutating host state

results.name: Signal Trap Status Preservation
results.assertion: Handlers must preserve exact POSIX signal termination exit codes
